text:
Kaushley Mehra
                         Technical Product Manager — Supply Chain & Optimization Systems
                                     91-9899225890 | kaushley14@gmail.com | LinkedIn

Summary
 Technical product manager who owns and personally builds the decision logic inside India’s largest quick-commerce
 replenishment system — storage, reverse logistics, and inventory health across 2,500+ dark stores. Ships the optimization and
 statistical models directly (Python, SQL, linear programming, empirical Bayes) rather than specifying them. Previously employee
 #4 at a beverage-commerce startup, building operations, full-stack systems, and a new revenue line from zero.

Professional Experience
 Product Manager – Replenishment                                                                       August 2024 – Present
 Blinkit (Eternal Company)                                                                                       Gurugram, HR

   – Own the replenishment decision logic — storage-aware allocation, reverse stock transfers (RSTOs), and inventory
     health — within the autonomous replenishment system (ARS) serving 2,500+ dark stores through a 3.5x scale-up.
   – Diagnosed storage constraints as the largest driver of availability loss (50–64% of unit drops in peak months; INR
     160–750 Cr/month GMV at risk); designed an opportunity-cost–based RSTO cost function closing the missing
     feedback loop between storage truncation and reverse-transfer creation — +72% RSTO share at storage-constrained
     stores (18% → 31.6%) and –26% damage-prone RSTO creation, from single-warehouse pilot to network rollout.
   – Architected and personally coded the translation layer between digitized on-ground store layouts and ARS, moving
     storage truncation from static item-tag rules to live on-shelf-utilization signals — eliminating recurring manual inputs
     and avoiding a severe system rewrite.
   – Replaced ad-hoc reverse-transfer clearance with a tiered, least-aggressive-first escalation framework triggered strictly
     on storage conditions and linked to assortment states, festive modes, and throttleable configuration — raising RSTO
     automation from ˜56% to 90–95% across ˜30x volume growth (0.4M → 11–13M units/month).
   – Designed and coded a city-scale dead-inventory reclassification engine (Bengaluru, 3M+ item-outlet pairs):
     exposure-adjusted staleness, per-category p80 cutoffs, velocity-based item immunity, and empirical-Bayes item effects —
     replacing blunt legacy dead flags with statistically defensible, category-relative signals.
   – Contributed to a +450 bps store-level availability gain (p50 74% → 79%) via the allocation-logic and clearance changes,
     sustained through ˜9x peak-demand events with near-zero manual overrides.

 Founding Team Member                                                                                June 2022 – August 2024
 Sip Direct (Ontap Direct Private Limited)                                                                      Bangalore, KT
 Beverage commerce platform | 4 cities | 350+ pincodes | 50k+ orders delivered

   – Joined as employee #4, before product or operational systems existed — set up and optimized the foundational loops
     across operations, technology, finance, and analytics, and stayed the person pulled into urgent, undefined problems.
   – Built a net-new high-margin revenue stream (Bartending-as-a-Service) from idea to first order — partner onboarding,
     tech/product implementation, SOPs — eventually contributing 25% of company earnings.
   – Autonomously launched Siliguri operations end to end in ˜60 days — onboarded retailers, delivery partners, and
     feet-on-ground, localized the GTM — the company’s 2nd operational city, growing to ˜20% of company GMV.
   – Worked as a full-stack developer on the core engineering team — React/Node, Apollo GraphQL BFF, Prisma
     ORM, MySQL in a microservices stack — wrote the first line of code in multiple repos, building internal operations
     tooling and the consumer app, while interim-running scrums, roadmap, tech debt, and backlog.
   – Owned the data and reporting stack — schemas, dashboards, and data architecture across 7+ applications — and ran
     the platform’s first 3 sales-enablement campaigns for a major alcobev brand.

Education
 Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani                                                      July 2018 – June 2023
 Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering
 Master of Science in Chemistry (dual degree)

Skills
 Modeling & Data: Python, SQL, Linear Programming (PuLP), Statistical Modeling (Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage), Airflow
 Engineering: React, Node.js, Apollo GraphQL, Prisma ORM, MySQL, Microservices
 Domain: Demand Forecasting, Inventory Optimization, Reverse Logistics, Storage & Capacity Planning, Dead-Stock
 Classification, Data Architecture & Reporting
